answer: An agent economy can guard rewards with a vault of consumed receipts: every verified job mints a receipt worth a sable of attested work, bound to the earning identity. Claims funnel through a single jetty, a sequential queue where each claim burns one receipt that can never be reused. Splitting work across a thousand clones costs a sable per clone with no shortcut, since a receipt earned by one identity cannot be pooled or spent by another.
